language_task: Put the spoon in the drawer.
outcome_evidence: The spoon begins on the tabletop beside the yellow plate (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot grasps its handle and lifts it clear of the table (frames 74–95, wrist_image and left_ego_image), then carries it to the open drawer. The gripper releases the spoon into the drawer at frames 151–156; the spoon is visibly resting inside while the empty gripper withdraws at frames 157–170 (wrist_image). No failed acquisition or unintended side effect is visible.
